notes.title: Câi & Darren: Code Calamity Update 4.2.0
notes.content: [p][/p][h1]Changes and Bug Fixes [/h1][p][/p][h2]Changes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Carried over various performance improvements from the upcoming mobile version of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved state indicators for battle chips in the pause menu.[/p][list][*][p]Chips will now display a green 'OK' or a red 'X' to indicate if they are enabled or disabled.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Enemies in battle will now show battle damage based on their health.[/p][/*][*][p]Gave Fatal Error a new attack that deals minor damage to both Câi and Darren.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more animations and indicators for selecting an enemy in battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking "continue" after beating the game will now drop you back in the HUB, instead of the credits.[/p][list][*][p]This will allow a sort of "Free Roam" mode.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]After placing both fuses, an indicator will appear in front of the lair door, requiring interaction to proceed.[/p][list][*][p]This ensures players do not accidentally enter the lair before they are ready.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hint Text in the pause menu is now one line and scrolls if too long, instead of being cut off.[/p][/*][*][p]Health Bars in battle now have a draining animation when taking damage.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed key items (Fuses, Code Snippets) not being saved properly and causing softlocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where falling off the right edge of the HUB would not respawn you.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sticky notes in terminals not being shuffled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the "import" sticky notes being oddly cropped out when placed on terminals.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Câi & Darren: Code Calamity Update 4.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed demo mode save files leading to a "save data corrupt" screen.
[*] Disabled achievements when in demo mode.
[*] Added a Killzone to the right area of the HUB room.
[/list]
